title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
summary: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.
author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
summary: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Vitalik Buterin calls for verifiable chips as hardware wallet threats evolve
summary: Buterin warned that future attacks could use lookalike chips with hidden malicious functions, making hardware tampering harder to detect.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
summary: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
summary: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
summary: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
summary: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
summary: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.
author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
summary: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.
author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
summary: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
summary: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.
author: Cointelegraph by Michael Egorov

title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
summary: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.
author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
summary: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
summary: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
summary: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.
author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
summary: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.
author: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
summary: HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
summary: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead
summary: With scalability, privacy tools and onchain liquidity improving, businesses may finally have the infrastructure to make enterprise blockchain work.
author: Cointelegraph by Paul Brody

title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down 3 years after $2.3B TVL peak
summary: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
summary: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: DTCC Plans Solana Expansion as Wallet Rules Limit Access
summary: The US securities clearinghouse plans to bring tokenized stocks to Solana in 2027, but analysts say restrictions could limit adoption.
author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
summary: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.
author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
summary: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
summary: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
summary: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
summary: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
summary: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
summary: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Blockchain is ‘perfect solution’ for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
summary: Sunny Lu said AI agents would need identity and reputation systems, making the case while promoting agent-building platform VeWorld.ai.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
summary: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
summary: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: ZachXBT identifies French bank as alleged victim of $133M crypto theft
summary: The French bank has not confirmed its alleged involvement in the crypto theft, which ZachXBT said could have resulted in losses exceeding $133 million.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Kraken restricts accounts linked to suspected $133M EU crypto theft
summary: Crypto.com also took steps to block funds tied to the suspected theft, while Kraken said its systems and customer accounts were not compromised.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
summary: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
summary: Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
